extDescription.message: Masks client data when you paste text into ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Gemini. Masking runs on your computer, with Shield Desk.

errDeskDownHelp.message: The text was not pasted. Start "uvx ragbase-shield desk", then paste again.

errTokenHelp.message: The text was not pasted. Open the extension options and paste the token shown by Shield Desk.

errExtensionHelp.message: The text was not pasted. Reload the page, then paste again.

errFileBlockedHelp.message: An attached file reaches the provider unmasked. Connect the folder in Shield Desk instead, or mask the file in the Files tab of Shield Desk.

optDossierWarn.message: No matter chosen: registered names become [PERSON] or [COMPANY], and the codes change at every paste, so restore is not possible. Choose the client matter.

optIntro.message: The extension masks the text you paste into AI chats, with Shield Desk running on your computer.

optTokenHelp.message: Copy the token from Shield Desk ("uvx ragbase-shield desk"). It stays in this browser.

optDossierNone.message: None (temporary masking: names cannot be restored)

optDossierHelp.message: Choose the client dossier: the same codes are then used to restore the names in the side panel.

optSites.message: Protected sites: chatgpt.com, claude.ai, copilot.microsoft.com, m365.cloud.microsoft, gemini.google.com.

optPrivacy.message: The extension only talks to Shield Desk, on 127.0.0.1. No telemetry. This is local, reversible pseudonymisation, not anonymisation.

optWarning.message: Do not attach client files to the chat: only pasted text is masked.

statusDown.message: Shield Desk is not running. Start "uvx ragbase-shield desk".

statusBadToken.message: Token refused: copy it again from Shield Desk.

spIntro.message: Paste the AI answer (with codes such as PERSONNE_A). The real names are shown here only.

spUnknown.message: Codes not in this dossier, please check: $CODES$

spLocalOnly.message: Do not paste this restored text into the AI chat.
